beats.display_text: Idea three is a small vocabulary. The colours always mean the same thing. Green is kept. Amber is undecided. Red is rejected.
Every choice you make lands on a timeline, which opens with Ctrl+Shift+L.
Zoom out and you see the shape of a session, bursts of drafting, stretches of cutting. Zoom in and each moment shows what changed.
You can replay a piece being written, then click any moment and start editing from there.
